author: targum-pseudo-jonathan

lemma.arc: וְרוּחַ רַחֲמִין מִן קֳדָם יְיָ מְנַתְבָא
lemma.en: and a spirit of mercies from before the LORD breathed

original.text: וְאַרְעָא הֲוַת תַּהֲיָיא וּבַהֲיָיא צַדְיָא מִבְּנֵי נַשׁ וְרֵיקַנְיָא מִן כָּל בְּעִיר וַחֲשׁוֹכָא עַל אַפֵּי תְהוֹמָא וְרוּחַ רַחֲמִין מִן קֳדָם יְיָ מְנַתְבָא עַל אַנְפֵּי מַיָא

english.text: And the earth was vacancy and desolation, solitary of the sons of men, and void of every animal; and darkness was upon the face of the abyss, and the Spirit of mercies from before the Lord breathed upon the face of the waters.

notes: Same 'spirit of mercies' as Neofiti; the verb menatva ('breathed / blew') keeps the Onkelos line. Etheridge embedded verbatim (PD).
